payload.name: Merge PDF Without Uploading by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup browser PDF merger for combining documents before upload.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based PDF merger for combining application pages, receipts, scans, forms, invoices, notes, and document packets into one PDF. It requires no account, keeps ordinary files local during use, and includes practical upload-size checks plus an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
